messages.subject: Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 61366246 failed: Error building image: Error building iplots
parts:
Hello All,

When trying to deploy to shiny apps we are getting the below error. Not able to idetify the resolution. This works fine on the local system but when trying to deploy to the web there is the issue.

Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 61366246 failed: Error building image: Error building iplots (1.1-7). Build exited with non-zero status: 1


Many Thanks
Chinmay
